## 1. 🧮 6 Interactive Vedic Mathematics Speed Simulators
One-line mental arithmetic algorithms formulated in the Atharva Veda:
- 1. Criss-Cross Universal Multiplication (Urdhva Tiryagbhyam): Multiply any two 2-digit numbers in 3 seconds with visual step-by-step carry breakdown (e.g. 43 × 62 = 2,666).
- 2. Squaring Numbers Ending in 5 (Ekadhikena Purvena): Multiply first digit by (digit + 1) and append 25 (e.g. 85² -> 8×9=72 -> 7,225).
- 3. Base 100 & 1000 Magic (Nikhilam Navatashcaramam Dashatah): Fast base deficit tracking and cross-subtraction (e.g. 96 × 93 = 8,928).
- 4. Instant 2-Second Square Roots (Vilokanam Observation): Computes square roots of 3- and 4-digit perfect squares purely by digit inspection (e.g. √5184 = 72).
- 5. Lightning 11-Multiplication (Antyayoreva): Fast mental arithmetic for multiplying any number by 11 by inserting adjacent digit sums (e.g. 63 × 11 = 693).
- 6. Historical Day-of-the-Week Calculator (Shakabda Chronometry): Vedic calendar modulo algorithm determining exact day of the week for any date in history (e.g. 15 Aug 1947 was Friday / Shukravara).
